title: Mechanical Design Engineer
text:
Mechanical Design Engineer

About the role
Design mechanical assemblies for industrial drive systems, from concept through production release.

Responsibilities
- Create 3D models and production drawings in CAD
- Apply GD&T and run tolerance analysis on assemblies
- Validate designs with FEA and physical testing
- Build prototypes using 3D printing and machining

Minimum qualifications
- B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering, graduating by June 2027
- Proficiency in CAD, ideally SolidWorks
- Working knowledge of GD&T
- Experience with FEA

Nice to have
- ANSYS
- 3D printing and rapid prototyping
- MATLAB or Python for analysis

Must be authorized to work in the United States.
